in_hebrew.name: Winnifred
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Friend of peace
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Winnifred הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English 'wynn' (joy) and 'frið' (peace). This name was popular in the Middle Ages and was often given to girls born into wealthy families. It conveys a sense of joy and tranquility, and is often associated with the Christian virtues of kindness and faithfulness.
